verse.verse_1: By those [angels] who range themselves in close ranks
verse.verse_2: and those who drive away [the wicked] with reproof
verse.verse_3: and by the reciters of the Reminder:
verse.verse_5: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between them; Lord of the Easts.
verse.verse_6: We have adorned the lowest heaven with the beauty of the planets;
verse.verse_7: and guarded it against all rebellious devils:
verse.verse_8: they cannot overhear the Higher Assembly for they are pelted from every side,
verse.verse_9: driven away, and will suffer eternal punishment.
verse.verse_10: But if anyone does succeed in snatching a glimpse [of such knowledge], he shall be pursued by a piercing flame.
verse.verse_11: So, ask those who deny the truth if it was harder to create them than all the other things We have created? We created them from sticky clay.
verse.verse_12: No wonder you are surprised as they laugh with scorn.
verse.verse_13: When they are reminded, they do not pay heed,
verse.verse_14: and whenever they see some sign, they ridicule it,
verse.verse_16: "What! When we have died and become dust and bones, will we be brought back to life again,
verse.verse_18: Say, "Yes indeed, and you will be brought low."
verse.verse_19: There will be but a single blast and then their eyes will open.
verse.verse_20: They will say, "Woe to us! This is the Day of Reckoning."
verse.verse_21: [It will be said], "This is the Day of Judgement which you have been denying."
verse.verse_22: But We shall say, "Assemble those who did wrong together with their associates and what they worshipped
verse.verse_23: besides God, and lead them to the path of the Fire;
verse.verse_24: and stop them there for questioning:
verse.verse_25: 'But what is the matter with you that you cannot help one another?,'"
verse.verse_26: indeed, on that Day they will surrender themselves.
verse.verse_27: They will turn upon one another, and question one another.
verse.verse_28: They will say, "You used to come at us from the right."
verse.verse_29: They will say, "No! It was you who would not believe --
verse.verse_30: we had no power over you; but you yourselves were a rebellious people.
verse.verse_31: But now our Lord's word has come true against us: truly, we are bound to taste [the punishment].
verse.verse_32: We led you astray as we were ourselves astray."
verse.verse_33: On that Day they will all share the punishment:
verse.verse_34: that is how We deal with evil-doers.
verse.verse_35: When they were told, "There is no deity but God," they turned away with disdain,
verse.verse_36: and replied, "Shall we then give up our deities at the bidding of a mad poet?"
verse.verse_37: "Surely, he has brought the truth, confirming those who were sent before;
verse.verse_38: you shall surely taste the painful punishment,
verse.verse_39: and be rewarded only according to your deeds."
verse.verse_40: But the chosen servants of God;
verse.verse_42: fruits of various kinds; and they shall be honoured,
verse.verse_44: seated on couches, facing one another.
verse.verse_45: A drink will be passed round among them from a flowing spring:
verse.verse_46: white and delicious to those who drink it,
verse.verse_48: With them will be spouses, modest of gaze and beautiful of eye,
verse.verse_50: They will turn to one another with questions:
verse.verse_51: one of them will say, "I had a friend,
verse.verse_52: who used to ask, 'Do you really believe that
verse.verse_53: after we die and become dust and bones, we shall be brought to judgement?'"
verse.verse_54: Then he will say, "Shall we look for him?"
verse.verse_55: Then he will look and see him in the midst of the Fire.
verse.verse_56: He will say, "By God! You almost brought me to ruin!
verse.verse_57: If it had not been for the blessing of my Lord, I would also have been taken to Hell."
verse.verse_58: Then he will say [to his blessed companions], "Are we not going to die,
verse.verse_59: except for our first death? Are we not going to be punished?
verse.verse_60: Truly, this is a great victory!"
verse.verse_61: It is for the like of this that all should strive.
verse.verse_62: Is that better by way of hospitality or the Zaqqum tree,
verse.verse_63: which We have made as a test for the wrongdoers.
verse.verse_64: For it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hellfire:
verse.verse_65: and its fruits are like devils' heads.
verse.verse_66: They will eat from it and fill their bellies with it;
verse.verse_67: then in addition to it they shall have a draught of boiling water to drink;
verse.verse_68: then surely they shall return to Hell.
verse.verse_69: They found their fathers had gone astray;
verse.verse_70: so they are rushing to follow in their footsteps.
verse.verse_71: And assuredly many of the ancients went astray before them,
verse.verse_72: though We had sent warners among them.
verse.verse_73: See how those who were warned met their end!
verse.verse_74: Not so the chosen servants of God.
verse.verse_75: Noah cried to Us, and how excellent was Our response!
verse.verse_76: We saved him and his people from great distress,
verse.verse_77: and We made his offspring the only survivors.
verse.verse_78: We left mention of him among later generations.
verse.verse_79: Peace be upon Noah among all the peoples!
verse.verse_80: That is how We recompense the righteous:
verse.verse_81: he was truly one of Our faithful servants.
verse.verse_83: Abraham was of the same faith:
verse.verse_84: he came to his Lord with a sound heart.
verse.verse_85: "Behold!" he said to his father and to his people, "What are these that you worship?
verse.verse_86: Would you serve false deities instead of God?
verse.verse_87: What do you think of the Lord of the Worlds?"
verse.verse_88: He looked up at the stars.
verse.verse_90: so they turned their backs on him and went off.
verse.verse_91: He turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
verse.verse_92: What is the matter with you that you do not speak?"
verse.verse_93: then he turned on them, striking them down with his right hand.
verse.verse_94: His people came rushing towards him,
verse.verse_95: but he said, "How can you worship things you carve with your own hands,
verse.verse_96: when it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?"
verse.verse_97: They said, "Build a pyre for him and throw him into the blaze!"
verse.verse_98: They wanted to harm him, but We humiliated them all.
verse.verse_99: He said, "I will go to my Lord: He is sure to guide me.
verse.verse_100: Lord, grant me a righteous son."
verse.verse_101: We gave him the good news that he would have a patient, forbearing son.
verse.verse_102: And when he reached the age when he could work with him, he said, "O my son, I have seen in a dream that I am sacrificing you. So tell me what you think of it!" He replied, "O my father, do as you are commanded; and God willing, you will find me steadfast."
verse.verse_103: When they had both submitted to God, and he had laid his son down on his face,
verse.verse_105: you have fulfilled the dream." It is thus indeed that We reward those who do good,
verse.verse_106: that surely was a manifest trial,
verse.verse_107: We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
verse.verse_108: and left him thus to be succeeded by a group [of followers] among later generations:
verse.verse_110: That is how We recompense the righteous:
verse.verse_111: truly, he was one of Our faithful servants.
verse.verse_112: We gave Abraham the good news of Isaac, a prophet and a righteous man,
verse.verse_113: and blessed him and Isaac too: some of their offspring were good, but some clearly sinned against their souls.
verse.verse_114: We also bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron:
verse.verse_115: We saved them and their people from great distress;
verse.verse_116: and We helped them, so that they were victorious;
verse.verse_117: and We gave them the Book which helps to make things clear;
verse.verse_118: and guided them to the straight path;
verse.verse_119: and We left them thus to be succeeded by a group [of followers] among later generations:
verse.verse_121: This is how We reward those who do good:
verse.verse_122: truly they were among Our faithful servants.
verse.verse_123: Elijah too was one of the messengers.
verse.verse_124: He said to his people, "Have you no fear [of God?]
verse.verse_125: Do you call on Baal and abandon the Best of Creators,
verse.verse_126: God your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?"
verse.verse_127: but they rejected him, and thus will certainly be called to account;
verse.verse_128: except the chosen servants of God.
verse.verse_129: We left him thus to be succeeded by a group [of followers] among the following generations --
verse.verse_130: "Peace be on Elijah and his people!"
verse.verse_131: It is thus indeed that We reward those who do good:
verse.verse_132: surely he was one of Our believing servants.
verse.verse_133: Lot was also one of the messengers.
verse.verse_134: We saved him and all his people,
verse.verse_135: except for an old woman who stayed behind,
verse.verse_137: You pass by their ruins morning
verse.verse_138: and night: will you not take heed?
verse.verse_139: Jonah too was one of the messengers.
verse.verse_140: He fled to the overloaded ship.
verse.verse_141: And then they cast lots and he was the one who lost,
verse.verse_142: and the fish swallowed him while he was blaming himself.
verse.verse_143: Had he not been one of those who acknowledge the glory of God,
verse.verse_144: he would certainly have remained inside the fish till the Day of Resurrection.
verse.verse_145: But We caused him to be cast forth on to the beach, sick as he was,
verse.verse_146: and We caused a gourd tree to grow over him.
verse.verse_147: We sent him as a messenger to a hundred thousand people or more,
verse.verse_148: and they believed in him: so We let them live in ease for a while.
verse.verse_149: Now ask them whether your Lord has daughters, whereas they have sons.
verse.verse_150: Did We create the angels females, to which they were witnesses?
verse.verse_151: No indeed! It is one of their fabrications when they say:
verse.verse_152: "God has begotten children." They are truly liars.
verse.verse_153: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
verse.verse_154: What is the matter with you? How do you form your judgement?
verse.verse_157: Then produce your scriptures, if you are telling the truth.
verse.verse_158: They claim that He has kinship with the jinn, yet the jinn themselves know that they will be produced before Him [for judgement].
verse.verse_159: God is far above what they attribute to Him,
verse.verse_160: but not so the true servants of God,
verse.verse_161: neither you nor what you worship
verse.verse_162: can lure away from God any
verse.verse_163: except those who will burn in Hell.
verse.verse_164: [The angels say], "Every single one of us has his place assigned:
verse.verse_165: we are those who stand ranged in ranks.
verse.verse_168: "If we had had with us a Book like that of the people of old,
verse.verse_169: we would surely have been God's chosen servants,"
verse.verse_170: but they have rejected it, [the Quran] and they shall soon learn!
verse.verse_171: And surely Our word has gone forth respecting Our servants, the messengers:
verse.verse_172: that it is certainly they who will be helped;
verse.verse_173: and that it is Our host that would certainly triumph.
verse.verse_174: So turn away from them for a while.
verse.verse_175: Watch them: they will soon see.
verse.verse_176: Do they really wish to hasten Our punishment?
verse.verse_177: When it descends on their courtyards, how terrible that morning will be for those who were warned!
verse.verse_178: So turn away from them for a while.
verse.verse_179: And watch, for they will soon see.
verse.verse_180: Glory be to your Lord: the Lord of Glory is far above what they attribute to Him.
verse.verse_182: and praise be to God, the Lord of all the Worlds.
